body.name: Certified whole-identified-set confidence region with observable-compressed error
body.construction:
Set \(L_n=n\) and \(\eta_n=1/n\).  Compute the simultaneous box \(\|\widehat P-P\|_\infty\le\rho_{n,\alpha}\).  For every finite open price stratum and every breakpoint value, use its own \(F_\kappa\) to compute rational primal and dual bounds \(d^-_{F_\kappa,n}\le d_{\kappa,L_n}(\widehat P)\le d^+_{F_\kappa,n}\) with gap at most \(\eta_n\), set
\[
 \underline D_{F_\kappa,n}
 =\max\{0,d^-_{F_\kappa,n}-e_{F_\kappa,L_n}\},
 \qquad
 e_{F_\kappa,L_n}
 =\min\left\{1,\frac{2(\min\{|F_\kappa|,m\}-1)}{L_n}\right\},
\]
and retain that parameter piece if and only if \(\underline D_{F_\kappa,n}\le\rho_{n,\alpha}\).  Separately use \(F_\infty\) to compute \(d^-_{F_\infty,n}\), set
\[
 \underline D_{F_\infty,n}
 =\max\{0,d^-_{F_\infty,n}-e_{F_\infty,L_n}\},
 \qquad
 e_{F_\infty,L_n}
 =\min\left\{1,\frac{2(\min\{|F_\infty|,m\}-1)}{L_n}\right\},
\]
and retain the terminal stratum \((K,+\infty)\) if and only if \(\underline D_{F_\infty,n}\le\rho_{n,\alpha}\).  The union is \(\widehat\Theta_{n,\alpha}\).
